title: K1 Circuit
specs: Outdoor electric go-karts capable of speeds over 80 mph
1.1 mile Pro Track layout and shorter North and South track layouts
Minimum age 13 years and 60 inches tall to race rental karts
Maximum weight 275 pounds for rental karts
Cadet drivers must be 7 to 12 years old and at least 50 inches tall
Kart owners must wear full abrasion-resistant karting suit, closed-toe shoes, full-face SNELL-approved helmet, and racing gloves
Neck collars and rib vests with chest protector mandatory for drivers under 16 and cadet categories
Minimum 8 racers for group events, 10 for corporate events
Private racing with reserved time and professional-style racing format

blurb: Guests race electric go-karts on outdoor tracks including a 1.1 mile Pro Track and shorter North and South layouts. Group events offer private racing with professional-style formats and trophies. Rental karts are electric, capable of speeds over 80 mph, and races last eight minutes each.
extraNote: Tarps or mats mandatory under every kart in paddock area to catch fuel and oil, $150 fine for non-compliance · Racers must take used tires, fuel cans, and large boxes with them; leaving at facility may result in $150 fine · Drivers prohibited from walking the track without authorization · No reservation required for individual racing; group events require booking for 8 or more · Races never expire; unused races can be saved for future visits
